verdict.rationale: Adyen's first-party docs say the API supports idempotency, so a request can be retried multiple times while the action is performed only once (adyen-docs-25). Developers enable this by sending an idempotency-key header (adyen-docs-4). Only two short doc snippets cover it, so it is unclear whether 'any' request is covered. missing for 10: which endpoints support idempotency, key lifetime/expiry and collision behavior, explicit handling of concurrent or in-flight retries, independent or hands-on corroboration that duplicate charges are prevented.
